title: Nothing drives the facade's PackageAddedTwice refusal end to end, and error_remedies.rs names the wrong file
body:
Nothing drives the facade's `PackageAddedTwice` refusal end to end, and error_remedies.rs's comment (about :1758) names the wrong file as the one that does.

Expected: an end-to-end arm that reaches the refusal, and the comment naming it.

Found by ST0096's close-time catch-up critics (vc, 2026-11-22, refs/bank/vc/st0096/close-H2-critic-rust-wp02-0709-20261122). Fixed under hv decision 86 for 3.5.1, dc's unit d86d.
